Questions

Before you start

Does it matter if I’m in a relationship right now?

No. The lessons are about your pattern, so they work whether you’re in a relationship, dating, or taking a break.

How long does it take?

Each lesson is short enough for one sitting. Most people finish in a week, and you keep access.

Is this therapy?

No. It’s a coaching and education course with practical tools. It isn’t therapy and doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here, see what changes, and decide later if you want to go deeper with Emily.

Script 1 · “Same ending, different person”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If every relationship seems to end the same way, the problem usually isn’t the other person.”

Body

“I see it all the time. Smart, capable women who can explain their pattern perfectly, after the fact. In the moment, it still runs the show. That’s because patterns don’t live in your head. They live underneath it, in what you believe you deserve and in whether you trust your own gut. Change that, and the pattern changes with it.”

CTA

“I put the whole process into a short mini course called The Pattern Reset. Five lessons, a workbook, a live Q&A with me, $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, natural light, your usual setting. On-screen text: “same ending?”

Script 2 · “Intuition or fear?”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“That feeling in your gut on the second date? It might be intuition. It might be fear. Here’s how to tell.”

Body

“Intuition is quiet and steady. It doesn’t panic. Fear is loud, urgent and usually sounds like something from your past. Most people were never taught the difference, so they either ignore every signal or follow every alarm. Learning to tell them apart is one of the fastest ways out of an old pattern.”

CTA

“Lesson 4 of The Pattern Reset is all about this. The full mini course is $27. Tap Learn more below.”

Shot: talking to camera, one cut to a text card: “quiet and steady” vs “loud and urgent”.

Script 3 · “Living proof”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I used to think real love was something that happened to other people.”

Body

[Your own short story in two or three sentences: the pattern you used to repeat and what changed it]

“What changed wasn’t finding the right person. It was changing what I believed I was worth, and learning to trust myself again. That’s the work I now teach.”

CTA

“If you want to start that work, The Pattern Reset is my 5-lesson mini course. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, warm and personal. On-screen text: “living proof”.
